topic.title: 현지 문화 및 관습과의 상호작용
topic.description: 여행 중 현지 문화를 존중하며 소통하는 방법을 배웁니다. 사원 방문 시 지켜야 할 예절을 알아봅니다.

korean_scripts.korean_text: 안녕하세요! 죄송하지만 길 좀 물어볼 수 있을까요?
가장 가까운 사원이 어디인지 알고 싶습니다.
감사합니다! 사원 방문 시 특별히 주의해야 할 문화적 관습이 있나요?
네, 사원에 들어갈 때는 신발을 벗어야 합니다.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Hello! Excuse me, could I ask for directions?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Hello! | Excuse me, | could I ask for directions?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, of course. Where are you going?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, of course. | Where are you going?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: I would like to know where the nearest temple is.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: I would like to know | where the nearest temple is.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Ah, you can go straight that way.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Ah, | you can go straight that way.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Thank you! Are there any cultural customs I should be aware of when visiting temples?
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Thank you! | Are there any cultural customs | I should be aware of | when visiting temples?

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Yes, when entering a temple, you must take off your shoes.
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Yes, | when entering a temple, | you must take off your shoes.

foreign_scripts.foreign_text: Ah, I see. Thank you for letting me know!
foreign_scripts.chunked_text: Ah, I see. | Thank you for letting me know!
